tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Please refer tender document for all the terms & conditions

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder shall have minimum three (3) years experience in Design, Manufacture and supply of High-pressure steam line valves of Class 3000SPL & above and shall have successfully supplied HP valves of class 3000SPL & above in IBR certified Form-III C to any of 660/800 MW capacity to any State / Central Thermal Power Station/any PSU. In proof of the same, the bidder shall upload Purchase order copies (not more than two) of order value of Rs.10.24 lakhs & above and its corresponding performance certificate.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Satisfactorily supplied past PO copy

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder shall be an IBR approved valves manufacturer of class 3000SPL & above and shall furnish Manufacturing Certificate in this regard. Copy of valid IBR certificate issued by Director of Boilers shall also be furnished for 3000SPL class and above valves as a proof.

The bidder shall have achieved, in his name/firm, an average annual turnover of Rs. 20.49 lakhs in at least two financial years in the preceding five financial years i.e., 2025-26, 2024-25, 2023-24, 2022-23 & 2021-22. As a proof of this, the bidder shall furnish Profit & Loss statement/ Balance sheet/Annual Turnover Certificate duly certified by chartered accountant.
The bidder shall enclose the technical information and drawing indicating all the dimensions duly marked on it along with the technical details.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relavant document shall be furnished

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Trade mark of the manufacturer shall be furnished in the offer and supply shall conform to the offer.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant document shall be furnished

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: All the valves shall conform to the specifications and dimensions of the existing M/s BHEL make HP valves for replacing the existing one.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant document shall be furnished

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: All valves shall have permanent valve specification details riveted on it.
